bookmark.return_note: Awaiting full spec. Equipment types, verification, availability tracking, matching algorithm needed.

IO1_direct_inputs.name: equipment_entry
IO1_direct_inputs.source: User adds equipment (generator, chainsaw, boat, pump, plow, tractor, medical kit, ham radio, satellite phone)

IO3_transformations.algorithm: INSERT equipment table. Track available/not_available toggle.

P.P1_bottleneck_analysis: Availability status updates (frequent toggles). Resource matching queries (find nearby available equipment).
P.P2_defensibility: User-reported (no verification needed for MVP). Availability toggle prevents over-matching.
P4_failure_modes: Availability status stale → equipment unavailable but shown as available (mitigate: periodic refresh, user notification)
P.P5_backup_plan: If unavailable check fails: show equipment with 'status unknown' warning.
P.P6_backup_plan_test: Test availability toggle. Test matching with unavailable equipment.
P.P7_testing_strategy: Unit tests for equipment CRUD. Integration tests for matching.
P.P8_benchmarks: Equipment entry: <200ms. Availability toggle: <100ms. Matching query: <1s for 50 nearby equipment.

L.L1_legal_considerations: User-reported equipment is self-certified (liability on owner). No verification required MVP.
L.L4_liability_notes: Owner responsible for equipment condition. Beacon not liable for equipment failure during use.

F.F3_revenue_impact: Equipment sharing enables mutual aid (retention driver).

S.S2_data_privacy: Equipment list visible to matched users only (during help matching).
S.S4_access_control: Owner controls availability. Matched users see equipment during event.

X.X1_notes: Equipment registry is simple but enables powerful resource sharing. MVP: user-entered equipment, self-reported availability. Future: verification, loan tracking, insurance integration.
X2_open_questions: Loan tracking: track who borrowed what? (liability concern, future feature)
Insurance: integration with insurance companies? (future monetization)
X.X3_related_research: Tool sharing platforms (ToolLibrary). Equipment matching algorithms. Liability in sharing economy.
